project.name: Synthetic offline countdown timer
project.summary: Single-user countdown timer; the developer reports no accounts, network calls or persistence.

distribution.notes: Developer describes a static downloadable page intended for Sri Lankan users; accessibility is not a legal applicability decision.

actors.notes: No identity or age is requested according to the developer.

features.name: Local countdown
features.description: Set a duration and receive a visual alert in the same page.

data_categories.name: Transient countdown duration
data_categories.retention: Memory until the page closes, per developer
data_categories.deletion: Closing or resetting the timer clears the value, per developer

data_flows.to: In-memory countdown in the same browser page

question_history.question: Who uses the timer and how is it offered?
question_history.answer_summary: A free direct-web timer for individual users; no accounts.

question_history.question: Which inputs are retained or sent anywhere?
question_history.answer_summary: Developer reports only transient countdown duration in local memory, with no persistence or network calls.

question_history.question: Which markets, vendors, commercial features and other material behaviors are involved?
question_history.answer_summary: Developer reports business and targeting in LK, no vendors, payments, marketing or sector-specific advice, and self-authored assets.

question_history.question: What access, retention and accessibility behaviors should the handoff record?
question_history.answer_summary: No shared data or privileged roles; reset/close clears memory; keyboard input and visual alerts are reported for later inspection.

Transient duration input is inventoried and linked to its reported local in-memory flow.

Developer reports no AI, third-party SDKs or external processing in the downloaded timer.
Developer reports no accounts, privileged roles, backend or shared tenant data; implementation remains reported.
